definitions.explanation: Describes something so cruel or violent that it is painful to witness. Used for scenes of destruction, violence, or mistreatment that evoke horror or pity.
Describes a state that is pathetically ruined or degraded, evoking sorrow or sympathy. Used when something once fine has been reduced to a miserable condition.

examples.japanese: {無惨|むざん}な⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無惨|むざん}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A brutal scene spread across the battlefield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{無惨|むざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{破壊|はかい}→破壊：13678_hakai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っていた→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The evidence photos showed buildings that had been cruelly destroyed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無惨|むざん}な⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧になっていた。
examples.english: The garden was in a wretched state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無惨|むざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荒|あ}らされていた→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧。
examples.english: After the typhoon, the flower bed had been pitifully ravaged.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦火|せんか}→戦火：21823_senka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}かれ→焼く：01123_yaku⟧、{無惨|むざん}な⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}していた→化す：29802_kasu⟧。
examples.english: The once-beautiful castle had been burned by the fires of war and reduced to a pitiful ruin.

notes:
VARIANT KANJI:
Also commonly written as {無残|むざん} or {無慚|むざん}. All three spellings are used interchangeably.

USAGE:
Used both as a な-adjective ({無惨|むざん}な⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧) and as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({無惨|むざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{殺|ころ}される→殺す：01944_korosu⟧). Often describes scenes that are too terrible or sad to look at.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無惨|むざん}な⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: wretched/pitiful state
- {無惨|むざん}な⟦{最期|さいご}→最期：30329_saigo⟧: tragic end
- {無惨|むざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{殺|ころ}される→殺す：01944_korosu⟧: be cruelly killed
- {無惨|むざん}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧: brutal/pitiful scene
